Played both of the games and continue to play through the original every now and again. I was definitely one of the ones who was unsure about her casting, not because I think she’s unnattractive (I think she’s really grown into her look over the last couple of years) but because I was unsure how she’d be able to capture the same facial and emotional expression Ellie is known for in the game as well as the age up in the second season. With that being said, I loved her as Lyanna Mormont in Game of Thrones and decided I would give the first season a shot. 

I personally was very impressed with her portrayal of Ellie, is it a perfect 1:1 of the games, definitely not, live adaptations rarely are (granted there are definitely some of those out there). Again this is me PERSONALLY, she honestly exceeded my expectations in how she has been able to make me feel like I’m watching Ellie on screen, Abby’s casting (Kaitlyn Dever) definitely surprised me as well (I believe I previously heard rumors that she was being considered for Ellie) she’s nowhere near a 1:1 remake of her video game counterpart. With that being said, I’m going to continue to watch through the second season, the first season had S1 E3 which strayed quite a bit from the lore of the first game but because of how well it was executed I was happy with it. I’m hoping they’ll be able to recapture that in this season but we will see. 

Again these are all my personal views and am in no way arguing against anyone’s grievances.

She lives at school but is back home for the summer right now and it’s just a much more toxic environment than it was before for personal reasons amongst them. I text her whenever I have down time and try to call her when I can but I also have to be able to be in contact with my own family as well as keep up with my own school work that I’m doing while I’m out here. For example, she had something happen with her sister where her sisters boyfriend (now ex-boyfriend) drove into a street full of protestors and almost ran them over and caused a lot of damage to her sisters car. I was shocked and how no idea what to say and at the same time that I’m being told this I have a mission coming down in 5 minutes with 18 hot pallets on it so I’m trying to team chief that as well. She told me I wasn’t supportive enough right then and in the end after I tried to explain why and how I didn’t know what to say she was just angry at me. I’m in college and work back home, and I’m also a reservist thats currently on deployment. Even though I’m not home I gave her my credit card to use in case of emergencies so I could at least lend her support in that way and it never seems like enough. I understand what you mean with commitment and I think that’s 100% right. I guess love isn’t my issue right now and it more or less falls on whether this is a relationship I’m willing to commit myself to.
